stories.title: Scheffler's Course-Record 61 Gives Him 3-Shot Lead at FedEx St. Jude Heading Into R3

stories.title: Spieth's Bogey-Free 65 Gives BMW Championship Hope — 54th to Projected Top 50

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Jordan Spieth entered the FedEx playoffs 54th in FedExCup — outside the top 50 BMW cutoff.

Then he went bogey-free. 65. R1 co-leader.

14th straight playoff year. Zero top-10s in the regular season. Still Spieth.

"In a very different place." 🙌

#JordanSpieth #FedExStJude
